headline: AI datacentres set to drive 70% rise in carbon emissions by 2030, IEA warns
claim: Data centre emissions are on course to rise about 70% by 2030, with AI driving about three-quarters of the growth in data centre electricity demand.
notes: published 2026-11-19 (page date read via WebFetch). Reports the IEA World Energy Outlook 2026 central-scenario projections. Forecast, not a measurement. Figures are global; the rise is tied to gas and coal supply in the US and China.

headline: Driven by US and China, Planet-Heating Emissions From Data Centers Set to Rise by 70% by 2030: IEA
